description: Rules for oracle strength levels. Strength determines what provenance evidence is required for certification.

strength_levels.description: Self-test only. The agent checked its own output without independent verification.
Visible/local check. A basic structural or behavioral check that is visible to the agent but deterministic.
Independent certifying verifier. A validator that is independently run and cannot be influenced by the producing agent.
External trusted verification. Human review, benchmark authority, or third-party trusted tool.

structural_oracle_limitation.description: STRUCTURAL_ORACLE alone cannot certify semantic success regardless of strength. A BEHAVIORAL_ORACLE or higher must also pass.
